first_failure_signal: critical service has equipment but no fuel, charge, black-start, or maintained backup
minimum_degraded_mode: manual priority fuel/charging allocation and islanded critical-load operation

first_failure_signal: money exists but safe contractors, materials, permits, or inspections are unavailable
minimum_degraded_mode: emergency repair standard plus mobile inspection and trusted contractor pool
assurance_test: post-disaster permit and contractor surge test

first_failure_signal: insured or eligible people cannot turn loss into usable recovery money
minimum_degraded_mode: paper/mobile claim intake, document substitution, partial advance, and appeal route
assurance_test: offline claim and document-loss case test

first_failure_signal: rain, tide, river, debris, or pump failure cuts off services
minimum_degraded_mode: manual clearance, temporary pumps, closures/detours, controlled release
assurance_test: pre-season drainage and compound-flood stress test

first_failure_signal: food, medicine, repair, childcare, cash-out, or local jobs disappear after shock
minimum_degraded_mode: temporary market, mobile vendors, working-capital advance, local procurement
assurance_test: essential-enterprise reopening and microbusiness access test

first_failure_signal: official service exists but low-trust or excluded people do not receive it
minimum_degraded_mode: trusted-messenger outreach, paper referral, community casework desk

first_failure_signal: food aid arrives but next season, herd, catch, or producer income fails
minimum_degraded_mode: input vouchers, local seed bank, mobile veterinary team, credit bridge
assurance_test: planting-season input and veterinary surge drill

first_failure_signal: official safety/closure claim lacks sampling, inspection, lab, or challenge path
minimum_degraded_mode: mobile/mutual-aid lab, priority sampling, provisional conditional clearance
assurance_test: lab reagent, mobile sampling, and inspection surge test

first_failure_signal: contractor, price, scam, or debt extraction rises after assistance or claims begin
dependencies: consumer protection;contractor licensing;legal aid;payment rails;inspectors;trusted media
minimum_degraded_mode: verified contractor pool plus multilingual complaint and rapid redress path
assurance_test: post-disaster contractor fraud and price-gouging red-team

first_failure_signal: families cannot identify, certify, mourn, bury/cremate, or receive death-related benefits
minimum_degraded_mode: temporary family assistance center and paper death-record workflow
assurance_test: mass-fatality surge and death-certificate outage drill

first_failure_signal: assistance or repair stalls because survivor cannot prove home, title, tenancy, or occupancy
minimum_degraded_mode: self-certification / affidavit with audit and legal-aid referral

first_failure_signal: repair money exists but code, permit, inspection, or upgrade finance blocks safe return
minimum_degraded_mode: emergency repair standard plus financed upgrade path
